result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Decide whether to invest in developing a dedicated handoff tracker tailored for small software development teams operating in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Discovery focused on small software development teams (under 50 members) in Latvia.
- Investigation of recurring handoff bottlenecks, manual status synchronization, and communication toolchains.
- Evaluation of willingness to adopt and pay for a standalone handoff tracking product versus existing project management tooling.
- Exclusion of any payroll, compensation management, or financial advisory functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Team Lead

Responsible for sprint execution, coordination between functional roles, and status tracking across projects.

- How much time does your team currently spend compiling and communicating handoff statuses across releases or cycles? (question-b7e80a831e7e8943dc081f48)
- Where do handoffs between design, engineering, and QA fail or slow down most frequently with your current toolset? (question-a9972afa69413673ac691540)

## Product Operations / Project Manager

Oversees cross-functional delivery workflows and tool adoption in small tech organizations.

- Under what conditions would your organization consider purchasing a specialized handoff tracking tool versus configuring existing tools? (question-64dd7435e69a54cd6fe246ab)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software teams in Latvia experience recurring friction during periodic status updates and handoffs.
- Teams currently rely on manual copying of statuses across disparate tools rather than automated workflows.
- Engineering teams have sufficient autonomy or budget discretion to trial and adopt lightweight collaboration tools.

## Evidence gaps

- No real-world customer interviews or empirical market validation from Latvian software teams exist yet; existing data is synthetic.
- Lack of data regarding typical tech stack configurations and incumbent tool satisfaction in the target Latvian market segment.
- Pricing tolerance and willingness to pay among Latvian small software businesses remain unverified.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
